An academic grade, better than a C and worse than an A.

s.g: The alternate or secondary part, such as the back side of a phonograph record. Contrasted with ‘A’, which is the primary part.
(music) The seventh note in the C major scale.
In the Maya calendar, a period of 144 000 days (20 k’atun periods): 394.25 solar years.
